hypotheses.H1_learning_gain: Adaptive platform increases normalized learning gain g by at least +0.25 (p < 0.05).
hypotheses.H2_dropout: Adaptive platform reduces Week 4 dropout rate from 45% to below 25% (p < 0.05).
hypotheses.H3_teacher_time: Automated code autograder & Socratic tutor reduce grading hours by >80%.

formal_ab_test_design.randomization_strategy: Stratified Block Randomization (blocked on baseline diagnostic pre-test ability into 4 strata)
formal_ab_test_design.spillover_prevention: Separate platform URLs, distinct discussion forum partitions, and randomized question parameter seeds.
